question: Can a scheme card that is not an ongoing scheme be abandoned?

expected.shortAnswer: No: only a face-up ongoing scheme card may be abandoned, and only during an Archenemy game.
expected.answer: 701.33a Only a face-up ongoing scheme card may be abandoned, and only during an Archenemy game. See rule 314, “Schemes,” and rule 904, “Archenemy.”
